Irrigation

Keeping your plant life watered can be a constant chore, but it doesn't have to be!

Free estimatesResidential & commercialCentral Florida
Get a free quote Call 407-717-8191

What this is

Irrigation across Central Florida.

The expert irrigation installers at BlueFox Landscape & Services across Central Florida can install your irrigation system to keep your plants thriving all year long. We can also repair irrigation systems to ensure they're working at an optimum level.

Irrigation is the quietest way to lose money on a landscape. A head knocked out of alignment waters a fence for years; a cracked line waters the ground under a driveway. You do not see either one — you see a dead patch somewhere else and assume the plant was the problem.

What's involved

How it works, and what shapes the quote.

Installation

New systems for residential and commercial properties, laid out for what is actually planted.

Existing systems

A system somebody else installed can be repaired too.

What affects the scope

  • New system, or repair of an existing one
  • Number of zones and what each one waters
  • Turf, beds and trees — they need different heads
  • Overspray onto walls, windows and walkways
  • Controller programming
  • Coverage gaps showing as dry patches

Every quote is based on the property itself — the estimate visit is where the measuring happens, and it is free.

Questions

Before you call.

My lawn has dead patches but the system runs. What now?

That is the classic symptom of coverage rather than supply — a head blocked by growth, knocked out of arc, or under-pressured at the end of a zone. It is usually a repair visit, not a new system.

Can you take over a system somebody else installed?

Yes. We repair existing irrigation systems as well as installing new ones.

Do you handle commercial irrigation?

Yes, residential and commercial.
